decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family in the firm's core hardware business, it likely has low carrying cost and proven enough demand by surviving the early portfolio pruning, so the option is worth keeping open.

This design-led handle appears less strategic than digital systems but, having remained beyond launch while similar weaker designs were removed, it likely still earns its place as a differentiated catalogue option.

Because the electronic access system is a stated flagship and directly fits the firm's move toward integrated digital building solutions, management would be inclined to continue backing it despite remaining uncertainty.
